# Fabsurprise Celebration Studio

> Fabsurprise is a luxury celebration studio based in Lagos, Nigeria. It creates bespoke gifts, proposals, surprise experiences, intimate celebrations and corporate gifting, and plans and delivers across Nigeria and internationally. Creating celebrations since 2017.

## How Fabsurprise works

- Every request starts with the person and the reason, not a fixed package.
- The studio handles everything from the idea to sourcing, setup, delivery and the moment itself.
- People living abroad can plan a gift, surprise or celebration for someone in Nigeria and are kept updated until the day.
- Plans can be kept private. A sender can stay anonymous to the recipient if they choose.
- Prices are not published. Each plan is quoted around what it involves.

## Services

- [Gifting](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/gifting.html): Curated gifts, gift boxes, hampers, money bouquets and keepsakes chosen around the person receiving them.
- [Surprises](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/surprises.html): Surprise planning, room and hotel decor, and surprise reveals, handled from setup to reveal.
- [Celebrations](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/celebrations.html): Planning and styling for intimate birthdays, civil weddings, anniversaries, dinners and family milestones.
- [Proposals](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/proposals.html): Proposal planning and styling built around the couple and the way they want to ask.
- [For Companies and Brands](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/corporate.html): Corporate gifting, employee appreciation, client gifting and brand experiences.
- [Celebrate From Afar](https://fabsurprisestudio.com/celebrate-from-afar.html): Gifts, surprises and celebrations planned from wherever the sender is and delivered where the recipient is.
